content:
laura: quick heads-up: python quickstart leaking raw req ids in JSON logs when DEBUG=1. looks like WSGI middleware + logging config ordering issue. saw it in a customer repro.

peter: can you paste a minimal log and how you start the app? gunicorn/uvicorn? structured logging lib?

laura: example log: `{"level":"DEBUG","ts":"2026-03-23T16:00:00Z","req_id":"req_ab12cd","path":"/v1/generate"}` — req_ab12cd should be redacted. start: `gunicorn -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker sampleapp.app:app` with logging configured via dictConfig in app.__init__.

sam: Python specifics: logging.Formatter gets applied early by dictConfig. Our otel/redact hook in telemetry.init registers a filter later, so formatted messages already contain raw values. Also retry code in httpx client clones headers into `x-rw-reqid-raw` which our redact filter didn't check.

laura: surprising because node had similar issues but we already patched there. want to make sure parity for python SDK too.

peter: fixes: 1) add telemetry.bootstrap() that runs synchronously and installs a logging.Filter before dictConfig runs (or recommend calling bootstrap in gunicorn config before app import); 2) normalize header clones in retry client and call redact on clones; 3) add a Formatter-level fallback that regex-replaces reqid-like tokens in message strings. keep fallback behind REDWOOD_LOGGER_SCRUB=false opt-out.

sam: also add an integration test using requests-mock to simulate a 502 then success, assert captured log JSON has "req_id":"[REDACTED]". run on py38/py310.

telemetry-bot: docs: https://playbook.redwood.ai/devex/telemetry/python-startup-order. Open ticket: infra#2021 to add python telemetry.bootstrap helper and header-normalize in httpx retry.

laura: pushed small PR: https://git.redwood/infra/sampleapp/pull/1314 — it moves telemetry.bootstrap into gunicorn config example, adds httpx clone normalization, and a formatter fallback behind REDWOOD_LOGGER_SCRUB.

ci-bot: CI run triggered for sampleapp/pr-1314. linux py310 green, mac flake (timeout) on integration.

peter: nice. once merged, we should add a short "Python quickstart telemetry" section in the onboarding guide showing where to call telemetry.bootstrap in common runtimes (gunicorn, uvicorn, flask run). include migration note about ordering.

sam: validated locally with gunicorn+uvicorn and DEBUG=1 — logs show "\"req_id\":\"[REDACTED]\"" after PR. closing once onboarding note is live. :white_check_mark:
